name: Campos del Paraíso (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Campos del Paraíso (a tree on red and a fleur-de-lis on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Campos del Paraíso; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Campos del Paraíso arms — tree and fleur-de-lis
